scripts.build: npm run prisma:generate && npm run build --workspaces
scripts.dev: npm run prisma:generate && npm run build -w @yohkar/database && npm run build -w @yohkar/shared && concurrently -n api,webapp,client-bot,admin-bot -c cyan,green,magenta,yellow "npm run dev -w @yohkar/api" "npm run dev -w @yohkar/webapp" "npm run dev -w @yohkar/client-bot" "npm run dev -w @yohkar/admin-bot"
